verified_facts.text: An Experience Center serves as a community hub with things to see, make and do.

verified_facts.text: Callaloo is an all-day cafe and Seafire is a sea-front restaurant centered around a fire pit.

verified_facts.text: Families have the Grow With Six Senses program and a Teens' Lounge.

verified_facts.text: The resort is centered around a natural saltwater lagoon.

verified_facts.text: In the thatched beachfront suites, each room offers direct access to a private pool and the ocean shore.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the thatched beachfront suites, where I stayed, each room (including the bathroom) is designed to offer direct access to a private pool and the ocean shore.

verified_facts.text: The villas, of up to four and five bedrooms, have cliffside views, living rooms, full kitchens, lap pools and private gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the villas (up to 4- and 5-bedroom) with dramatic cliffside views, guests can expect even more space: living rooms, full-fledged kitchens, lap pools, and private gardens.

verified_facts.text: Wellness facilities include a gym, a yoga room and a biohacking recovery lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: A full-fledged gym, yoga room, and a biohacking recovery lounge offer everything from aerial yoga to pulsed electromagnetic field therapy and sleep tracking.

verified_facts.text: The resort is about a 35-minute drive from Grenada's international airport.

verified_facts.text: The resort is set away from St. George's, Grand Anse beach and the rainforest treks, each about 30 minutes by car.
